alt: promotion (a rise to a higher job or rank)
note: «Он получи́л повыше́ние на рабо́те» can only be "He got a promotion", a job-grade sense that neither "increase" nor any existing alt reaches.

alt: provision (a clause of a law or agreement)
note: «Они́ обсужда́ли но́вые положе́ния зако́на» needs the legal-clause sense "provisions", which "position" and "situation" do not cover.

alt: waist (the narrow middle of the body)
note: «Вода́ дошла́ мне до по́яса» means the water reached my waist — the body-part sense is only mentioned inside the standard note, so it is never an accepted answer.

alt: placement (a student's spell of supervised work as part of training)
note: «Студе́нт прохо́дит пра́ктику в больни́це» is a hospital work placement, not "practice" in the repeated-exercise sense the gloss gives.
«Он отказа́лся от предложе́ния» needs "offer", which is already listed as an alt alongside "proposal".

alt: object (a physical thing you can pick up)
note: «На столе́ лежа́ло мно́го предме́тов» means objects on a table, a sense named only in the standard's parenthetical and so not graded as an answer.
«Госте́й встре́тили тёплым приёмом» needs "reception", which the entry already carries as an alt.
«Продаве́ц помо́г мне вы́брать пода́рок» was flagged only for using "shop assistant", which is already an accepted alt.
«Здесь нет прое́зда для маши́н» needs "passage", which is already listed as an alt.

alt: minutes (the written record of a meeting)
report (an official police record of an incident)
note: «Секрета́рь вёл протоко́л собра́ния» is "kept the minutes" and «Поли́ция соста́вила не́сколько протоко́лов» is police reports; the bare gloss "protocol" accepts neither.

alt: interest (the payment a bank makes or charges on money)
note: «Банк предлага́ет высо́кий проце́нт» is a high rate of interest, a financial sense neither "per cent" nor "percentage" covers.

alt: burst (the explosion of a shell)
note: «На фро́нте слы́шались разры́вы снаря́дов» needs "bursts"; the explosion sense sits inside the standard's parenthetical and is never accepted as an answer.
«Они́ боя́лись бли́зкого расстава́ния» renders "separation", which the existing alt "parting" already reaches.

alt: mortar (the mix that bonds bricks)
note: «Ка́менщик заме́шивал раство́р» can only be mortar, and although the standard names it after a semicolon, only the text before the first bracket is graded.
All five sentences, including «Ребя́та сыгра́ли в футбо́л во дворе́», use "guys", which is the standard gloss already.
«Врач вы́писал реце́пт на лека́рство» needs "prescription", which is already an accepted alt.

alt: gender (a noun's grammatical class)
note: «Э́то сло́во же́нского ро́да» needs the grammatical sense, which the standard only mentions parenthetically and therefore never accepts.
The flagged «На пра́здник прие́хала вся родня́» was a translation-consistency note, and "relatives" is in any case already an alt.

alt: fee (a charge levied for entry or a service)
note: «За въезд беру́т небольшо́й сбор» is a charge for entry, a sense named only inside the standard's parenthetical and so not graded.
«Мяч попа́л в се́тку» needs "net", which the entry already lists as an alt.

alt: consequence (a result that follows from a cause)
note: «Боле́знь ста́ла сле́дствием уста́лости» requires "consequence", a sense mentioned only in the standard's parenthetical and never accepted as an answer.
Both flagged sentences («По го́роду хо́дят слу́хи», «Не ве́рь э́тим слу́хам») need "rumour", which is already an alt.
«Произошла́ сме́на руково́дства» is a change of leadership, which the existing alt "replacement" already reaches; adding bare "change" would only loosen grading against изменение and перемена.

alt: meeting (a work discussion called by a manager)
note: «Дире́ктор провёл совеща́ние» and «Совеща́ние перенесли́ на за́втра» both render "meeting", which the single gloss "conference" does not accept.

alt: creature (a living being, in an elevated or affectionate tone)
note: «Э́то стра́нное созда́ние живёт в мо́ре» needs "creature", a sense the act-of-making gloss cannot reach.

alt: fortune (a large amount of accumulated wealth)
note: «Он накопи́л огро́мное состоя́ние» needs "fortune", which neither "state" nor "condition" covers.

alt: remedy (a preparation that treats an ailment)
note: «Э́то хоро́шее сре́дство от ка́шля» is a cough remedy, a medicinal sense absent from "means".

"Old lady" in «Я уступи́л ме́сто стару́шке» is the same sense as "old woman" in a warmer register, not a missing sense — the real defect is the standard note failing to mark the affectionate diminutive against стару́ха, which no alt can fix.

«Стволы́ сосе́н высо́кие и прямы́е» and «На стволе́ де́рева сиди́т жук» are tree-trunk sentences that belong under the separate ствол=trunk headword; adding a "trunk" alt here would duplicate that entry rather than fix the filing.

alt: pole (an upright support, such as a tent pole)
note: «Пала́тку де́ржат две сто́йки» needs "poles"; the bar-counter sentence is covered by the existing "counter" alt and the newspaper rack by "stand", but the upright-support sense is graded nowhere.

alt: system (a country's political and social order)
note: «В э́той стране́ был друго́й строй» needs "system" in the socio-political sense, which the standard names only inside its parenthetical.

alt: trial (the hearing of a case before a judge)
note: «Суд начнётся за́втра у́тром» must be "the trial will begin" — a court cannot "begin" in English — and the gloss "court" (the institution or place) does not accept it.
All three flags concern sentences leaving сы́рник untranslated as "syrnik(i)", and the transliteration is already carried as an alt.

alt: creative work (an artist's body of work)
note: «Мы изуча́ем тво́рчество поэ́та» and «В его́ тво́рчестве мно́го све́та» mean the poet's oeuvre, which the abstract-quality gloss "creativity" does not accept.

alt: appliances (household machines such as a fridge or washer)
note: «Магази́н продаёт бытову́ю те́хнику» means household appliances, a concrete-equipment sense neither "technology" nor "technique" grades as correct.
The only flag on «Грузови́к везёт то́нну угля́» is about "truck" vs "lorry" in the sentence; the gloss "tonne" covers both usages.
«Музыка́нт игра́ет на трубе́» needs "trumpet", which is already an accepted alt.

alt: charcoal (burnt wood used for drawing)
note: «Он нарисова́л портре́т углём» can only be "with charcoal", a sense the fuel gloss "coal" does not reach.

alt: whisker (a stiff hair on an animal's muzzle)
note: «Кот шевели́т уса́ми» is a cat's whiskers, which the human-moustache gloss does not cover.

alt: workings (the internal make-up of a machine)
note: «Он разбира́ется в устро́йстве маши́ны» means he understands how the car is put together, not any "device".
